cheap.notes: Keep simple repetitive work local and escalate only when quality or write access demands it.

balanced.notes: Use the best planner, specialized builders, and a strong final reviewer.

premium.notes: Favor the highest-quality planner and reviewer lanes on risky work.

quick_ping_strategy: Prefer local config, auth, or cached state before a heavy CLI status call.
Hide console windows and keep probes short.
Cache quick ping results for repeated checks.
deep_ping_strategy: Send a compact deterministic request that proves a real roundtrip.
Capture framework label, target model or agent, and visible assistant text.
Return the permission posture used for the probe.
